data_contract.eligibility: 60 valid observations, previous-session volume>=10000, previous 20-session median turnover>=KRW500m
data_contract.signal: factor score at close[t] against highs/bands ending t-1
data_contract.entry: open[t+1]; failed/missing/limit-up slot remains cash without replacement
data_contract.corporate_action_proxy: each positive open-to-open transition capped at +30%; negative transitions uncapped; missing transition marked flat
data_contract.position_accounting: net repeated names at episode boundary; charge actual valid entry/exit sides

selection: highest Train Sharpe among Train cumulative>0 and Train MDD>=-35%; Test unused

blocking_reasons: current-400 panel is not a point-in-time universe
corporate actions are capped proxies rather than ledger-adjusted prices
missing/suspended exits use mark-flat instead of carry-to-next-tradable-session
